# cachefly_edge_control_kv (Data Source)

Reads an edge control key/value store: the account-level store, the store of one service, or, with `merged`, the account store merged with the service store as the service's edge scripts see it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Account-level store
data "cachefly_edge_control_kv" "account" {}

# Store of one service
data "cachefly_edge_control_kv" "service" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
}

# What the service's edge scripts see: account keys overridden by service keys
data "cachefly_edge_control_kv" "merged" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
  merged     = true
}

output "merged_kv" {
  value = data.cachefly_edge_control_kv.merged.data
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `merged` (Boolean) Return the account store merged with the service store; service keys override account keys. Requires `service_id`.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the service whose store is read. Leave unset to read the account-level store.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the store was created. Not set when `merged` is true.
- `data` (Dynamic) Keys and values of the store.
- `id` (String) `account`, the service ID, or `service_id:merged`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the store was last updated. Not set when `merged` is true.
